questions.question: The LORD said Moab would be captured. What would happen to Moab's false god Chemosh and his priests and officials?

answers.text: They would keep Moab's land safe

questions.question: The LORD said to put salt on Moab because she would be laid waste. What would her cities become?

answers.text: Empty with no one living in them
Crowded with people running from war
Fortresses for the destroyer to keep

questions.question: The LORD compared Moab to wine left settled in its jars and said He would send wanderers. What would they do?

answers.text: Pour him out and shatter his jars
Carry his jars off as plunder
Tear down the walls around him

questions.question: The LORD, the King, said the best of Moab's young men would win the battle against the destroyer. True or false?
